name: Lavender
use: Scent for the wardrobe, a feast for bees.
description: A shrub with silver leaves and purple flower spikes. The whole plant smells sweet when you brush past it.

img.alt: A single lavender stem and a small bunch tied with string, both with purple flower spikes

growing.water: Little water, soil that drains well

harvest: Cut the flower spikes when the first flowers open.
